run3_preserved.why_preserved: reproducible reading; no data criterion relaxed

defect_found_in_run3_instrument.defect: The unbound-reviewer list was built by appending a reviewer for any union record of that reviewer that is not hash-bound. worker-093 has two revise records: the reviews/*.json file (EXACT_FIELD, hash-bound) and the accepted-stream record (UNBOUND, no hash field). The run-3 text therefore printed 'worker-093:UNBOUND' in the list of named revises that are not hash-bound, which contradicts the sentence preceding it and overstates the defect. The underlying measurement (worker-093 has a hash-bound revise) was already correct in the snapshot and in the preceding clause.
defect_found_in_run3_instrument.fix: Classify each named reviewer once: hash-bound iff the reviewer has at least one hash-bound revise record in the union. Report the two sets separately. No measurement, criterion, binding_class or decision changes.

falsifier: Unchanged from prereg.json. Additionally: any per-reviewer hash-bound classification that cannot be recomputed from snapshot/union_records.json voids the L0U-04 reviewer split.
